newsitem.title: USA: IBM to close Web shopping mall - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: IBM to close Web shopping mall - WSJ.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp is preparing to shut down the "virtual" shopping mall it opened last year, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Tuesday's electronic edition, the Journal said IBM plans to close "World Avenue," a shopping mall it opened on the World Wide Web.
The site apparently brought in little revenue for the stores that were displayed, as well as for IBM.
Instead, IBM now plans to limit itself to supplying technology for shopping ventures on the Internet that are operated by others.
"We do not want to get in between our customers and their customers," a spokesman said.
World Avenue is expected to shut down on July 9.
